rooms.mobileIntro: The ClubSport app for iOS and Android will use two capabilities the web cannot offer:
rooms.mobileNfc: each gym has a terminal at the entrance (identifier above). Tapping your phone marks you present in a second, with no need to stop at the desk. The field that records how a check-in happened already exists in the database.
rooms.mobileGeo: sessions will be sorted by real distance from your phone’s position, so the gym you are standing in comes first. Each gym’s coordinates are already stored and used for that calculation.

faq.metaDescription: Membership, booking, cancelling, attendance: answers to the most common questions about ClubSport.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything worth knowing before joining the club.
faq.q1: How do I book a session?
faq.a1: Once your account is created and onboarding is done, go to “Book”. Filter by gym or class, then click the session you want. Remaining spots are shown in real time.
faq.a2: You can cancel freely until the session starts. Once it has begun, cancelling is no longer possible and the session moves to your history.
faq.q3: What if a session is full?
faq.a3: The booking button is disabled and the session is marked “Full”. There is no waiting list yet — a known limitation of this version.
faq.a4: Your coach marks attendance from their own screen at the start of the session. Your history and statistics update immediately.
faq.a5: Yes. Your home gym is chosen during onboarding, but your membership covers all three. You can change it any time in your settings.
faq.a6: A membership can be suspended by club staff. While it is inactive, booking new sessions is blocked — your existing bookings stay visible.
faq.a7: Yes. A React Native app is planned, with NFC check-in at the gym entrance and sessions ranked by real distance using geolocation.
faq.moreText: The club team answers in person, at all three gyms.
